CA.rationale: Content (red positions) is explicitly linked to processing-origin entries for the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: For p0/current/n3 the report gives the content coordinates, a presentation/listing and a distinct origin/status entry.

A.rationale: Content entries are explicitly annotated with processing-origin kinds (e.g. command_estimate), linking processing condition to that content's representation.

C.rationale: The report lists identified content (color-coded coordinate sets) and attributes (red/blue) for current entries.

D.rationale: Each content entry is provided alongside a separate origin/status field, distinguishing identity from status/pedigree.

O.rationale: Content coordinate listings show how each item is presented/organized in the record (bound to referent and time).
